title: Untreue (Das zerbrochene Ringlein)
video_use_ideas: A simple choral folk song for a human, old-country beat.
legal_notes: Mutopia piece 621: LilyPond header sets the edition licence to CC BY 4.0. Typesetter: Klaus Rettinghaus. Composition is PD-EU (life+70) and PD-US (published before 1930). CC BY: credit the typesetter and the Mutopia piece page, and link the licence. Header composer is Friedrich Glück (1793–1840), 1814; arranger line is Bearbeitung von Max Reger (1873–1916), 1913. The tune is Glück's In einem kühlen Grunde. Both the song and Reger's arrangement are PD; the edition is CC BY 4.0. The piece is about 30 seconds. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
licence_meaning: CC BY somewhere in the row. Commercial use OK with the credit line in the post / video description.
